items.headline: AI coding agents consume far more tokens than simple prompts
items.summary: When developers give an AI agent a coding task, the agent plans, writes, tests and iterates, using ten to fifty times more tokens than a basic chat prompt.
items.why_it_matters: Higher token usage affects cost and measurement of AI‑driven development tools.
items.evidence_quote: A single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic chat prompt

items.headline: OpenAI to respect robots.txt signal for AI training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI will honour a shared robots.txt signal that lets website operators convey their AI‑training preferences to participating providers.
items.why_it_matters: Gives web owners control over how their content is used to train AI models.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers

items.headline: OpenAI adds stronger violence prevention safeguards to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding safeguards, introducing earlier interventions and committing to public safety reporting to improve violence prevention in ChatGPT.
items.why_it_matters: Enhances user safety and transparency around harmful content handling.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting

items.headline: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
items.summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
